season.evidence: Pages give late June through early fall for the Lyman Lakes peaks with an axe useful early; logged ascents Jun-Oct (15 July, 17 Aug, 5 Sep); stored Jul-Sep. Oct 13 report is within a month of the end.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 2024-10-13 report matches the traverse (Cloudy Pass, Cloudy Peak west ridge, south ridge, talus, North Star), summit 33 m from our pin, but the track is partial (245 points) starting at Cloudy Pass, not a trailhead.
Direct cross-country from Lower Lyman Lake, the East Route line.
Long Phelps-side loop that also visits Dark Peak.

facts.text: After Cloudy's summit, leave the south ridge near 7,640 ft and break northeast onto a ledge system that drops to the talus without exposure.
Do not follow the false summit southeast of the true top; take the obvious chossy gully (class 1) to the real summit.
Cloudy's summit block is passed on its east side by a very short class 3 chimney with good holds.
Talus fields on the crossing between the two summits hold loose boulders that shift underfoot.

season.evidence: Pages say summer and fall with an ice axe early; July-Aug reports show lingering snow; stored Jul-Sep with August best.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 2024-09-01 track from Lower Lyman Lake to the summit, partial (not from a trailhead) and the report names no route.
Long loop, October, also reaches Dark Peak.

facts.text: In early July the final steeper snow slope to the col below the summit block is where light crampons and an axe are useful; the talus below was soft and pleasant.
In early August mosquitoes and no-see-ums are relentless at the Cloudy Pass camp; bring a bug shelter.
Water is plentiful in early July across the heather slopes below Cloudy Peak.

notes: Packet lists East Route with 1158 existing track points. No qualifying complete track exists in the harvest for either route (all partial or from other trips).
